params.name: options
params.doc: The options for the body limit middleware.

guarantees.text: when the request has a "Content-Length" header larger than `maxSize`, calls `onError` without reading the body
without "Content-Length", reads the body as a stream and calls `onError` once more than `maxSize` bytes were read
a body of at most `maxSize` bytes reaches the handler unchanged

params.name: options
params.doc: The options for the CORS middleware.

guarantees.text: without `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to "*"
with a string `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to it
with an array `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to the request origin when the array contains it
with a function `origin`, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" to what it returns for the request origin
without `allowMethods`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" listing "GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "POST", "DELETE", "PATCH" and "QUERY"
with `allowMethods` (an array, or a function of the origin), a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" listing those methods
with `allowHeaders`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" listing them; the default list is empty
with `maxAge`, a preflight gets "Access-Control-Max-Age" set to it
with `credentials` true, sets "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"
with `exposeHeaders`, sets "Access-Control-Expose-Headers" listing them; the default list is empty
sets `requestId` on the context to a new id from `generator`, by default `crypto.randomUUID()`
when the request has the header `headerName` (default "X-Request-Id"), uses its value instead of generating one
with `headerName` "", the request header is ignored
a request id longer than `limitLength` (default 255) is not used
returns a CSP source of the form "'nonce-<value>'" and stores the value as `secureHeadersNonce` on the context

params.name: customOptions
params.doc: The options for the secure headers middleware.

guarantees.text: with no options, sets "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy" "same-origin", "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy" "same-origin", "Origin-Agent-Cluster" "?1", "Referrer-Policy" "no-referrer", "Strict-Transport-Security" "max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains", "X-Content-Type-Options" "nosniff", "X-DNS-Prefetch-Control" "off", "X-Download-Options" "noopen", "X-Frame-Options" "SAMEORIGIN", "X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies" "none" and "X-XSS-Protection" "0"
removes the "X-Powered-By" header
"Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy" is not set by default; with `crossOriginEmbedderPolicy` true it is "require-corp"
an option set to false leaves its header out
an option set to a string sets its header to that string
with `contentSecurityPolicy`, sets "Content-Security-Policy" from the directives, each camelCase directive written in kebab case with its values separated by spaces
with `contentSecurityPolicyReportOnly`, sets "Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only" the same way
with `reportingEndpoints`, sets "Reporting-Endpoints"; with `reportTo`, sets "Report-To"
with `permissionsPolicy`, sets "Permissions-Policy"
a directive holding `NONCE` gets a nonce value, and the same nonce is available as `secureHeadersNonce` on the context
